lens: scoped maintenance, exact session authority, recovery and native result visibility
scope: internal source and synthetic Simulator workflow

verification.native_cache_claim: unverified; preserved after restart and explicit stop

resolved_findings.finding: Late validation could reopen the signed-out session.
resolved_findings.correction: Durable ending intent plus generation invalidation before effects.

resolved_findings.finding: Removing an older identity could delete newer credentials or miss its old slot after revocation data was discarded.
resolved_findings.correction: Exact fingerprint and retained non-secret identity-slot reference.
resolved_findings.proof: Signed Keychain orphan-slot and newer-sign-in preservation tests.

resolved_findings.finding: Shared-cache clearing does not establish zero occupancy.
resolved_findings.correction: Observe bytes and keep nonzero results unverified.
resolved_findings.proof: Native 144,016-byte receipt survives relaunch and stopping; controlled URLCache separately reaches zero.

resolved_findings.finding: Recovery controls and result rows were not reliably reachable through the native accessibility tree.
resolved_findings.correction: Explicit containment, combined result rows, stable operation values and receipt scrolling.
resolved_findings.proof: Final English and Chinese native journeys.

limits: No real Apple sign-out or TestFlight release.
No empty server test workspace or independent Demo reset.
Unreadable protected recovery is preserved and blocked; automatic journal repair is not implemented.
Full Lab implementation goal remains active.
